record.file_problem: The provided text contains the README and file list, not the contents of the listed reports/PDFs. Results below are limited to what the README states.
record.tranche_reason: The README reports tracing and interventions on a held-out difference-in-means refusal direction, but the interventions are single-position patching/addition under prefilling attacks rather than the original all-layer, all-position ablation.
record.gate_note: The README reports behavioral refusal, direction-projection changes, and intervention outcomes. It does not give exact patching cells, layers, additive strengths, or numerical confidence intervals. Direction-extraction values used to define the direction are not reported as findings.
record.test_reason: Uses the Arditi difference-in-means direction (held-out set) on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct. It traces how prefilling attacks shift its projection and tests whether single-position patching or addition of the direction restores refusal or induces it on benign prompts. These are V1-style causal interventions at a different granularity, plus a test of the V3 mechanism.
record.authors_conclusion: Correct. The late-layer refusal-direction signal is a real, prompt-level-predictive readout of the attacked state, but not the causal lever at the single-position granularity tested. Compliance may be locked in during the prefill or by downstream computation.
record.recipe_differences: Course-project repository reporting a held-out difference-in-means direction, tracing, single-position patching, and additive interventions. It does not report the original all-layer, all-position ablation; repository contents were not read or run.
record.method_sensitivity: The README reports a monotone-by-depth projection gradient across layers 16, 20, 24, and 27. It bounds the causal conclusion to single-position residual edits; intervention cells, exact positions, and additive strengths are not specified in the provided text.
record.problems: Evidence is limited to README summaries; the listed reports were not provided as readable content. The README reports one model and prefilling attacks, does not enumerate patching cells or intervention strengths, and gives no numerical confidence intervals beyond saying they include zero for patching.
record.rows_left_out: None. The README's headline results relevant to the listed versions are included; repository files and scripts were not run, and listed report contents were unavailable.

reader_labels.label: challenges
reader_labels.condition: Single-position patching and late-layer addition in attacked Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct prompts
reader_labels.reason: The reported patching does not restore refusal and adding the vector restores refusal in 0 of 300 prompts; the benign control also reports zero false-refusals (r7–r9). These results challenge causal sufficiency at the tested intervention granularity, not the untested all-layer/all-position ablation.

reader_labels.label: limits_scope
reader_labels.reason: Prefilling coincides with lower refusal and a shifted refusal-direction projection (r1–r6), but the reported patching/addition interventions do not recover refusal (r7–r8). The README therefore limits the causal account to interventions tested and suggests compliance may be locked in earlier or by downstream computation.
